record.paper_title: String Theory on ADS3: Some Open Questions
record.context_brief: exact AdS string theory and AdS/CFT checks
record.original_question: What is the exact structure of the fundamental string theory on an anti-de Sitter background, and how does that exact string theory connect to the super-Yang–Mills or boundary conformal field theory expected from the AdS/CFT correspondence, including the computation of AdS3 string-state correlators needed for rigorous checks?

evidence.quote: Since the supergravity theory under consideration is the low-energy limit of a more fundamental superstring theory, the question arises of the exact structure of the latter on the anti-de Sitter background, and its connexion to the super-Yang–Mills theory on the boundary.
Ideally, we would like to compute correlators in both sides and compare them. In practice, correlators for ADS3 string states are out of reach, which makes any rigorous check quite intricate.
as long as one does not handle the ADS3 side exactly, the achievements are limited both on checking the ADS/CFT correspondence, and on building the boundary theory.

artifact.status_search_result: Significant progress has been made, especially at the minimal-tension point k=1 with pure NS-NS flux, where the worldsheet theory on AdS_3 × S^3 × T^4 has been shown to be exactly dual to the symmetric orbifold Sym^N(T^4), with tree-level n-point correlators matched via a localization onto holomorphic covering maps (Eberhardt–Gaberdiel–Gopakumar and follow-ups, including the 2024 "Solving AdS_3 string theory at minimal tension: tree-level correlators"). However, an exact formulation and correlator-level match for general level k and for mixed/pure R-R flux backgrounds remains open.

status_evidence.title: Solving AdS3 string theory at minimal tension: tree-level correlators
status_evidence.snippet: A free-field description at k=1 with localization of string amplitudes; tree-level match with symmetric orbifold correlators.
status_evidence.claim: Exact correlator-level match at minimal tension (k=1) with pure NS-NS flux has been established at tree level.

status_evidence.title: Deriving the AdS3/CFT2 correspondence
status_evidence.snippet: Worldsheet theory at k=1 shown to be dual to Sym^N(T^4) symmetric orbifold CFT.
status_evidence.claim: The AdS_3/CFT_2 duality has been derived rigorously at the special point k=1.

status_evidence.title: String correlators on AdS3: Analytic structure and dual CFT
status_evidence.snippet: Analyzes analytic structure of AdS_3 worldsheet correlators and worldsheet instanton singularities.
status_evidence.claim: Worldsheet correlators on AdS_3 are computable in specific regimes but their full structure for general k is still being elucidated.
